title: The 'Woe to Them' Words in Isaiah 5
description: The prophet Isaiah pronounces a series of 'woe to them' statements against greedy landowners, drunkards, those who call evil good and good evil, the self-proclaimed wise, and those who take bribes. Because the people have rejected the Lord's law, exile, the gaping mouth of Sheol, and the outstretched hand of the Lord's wrath are foretold [ref:Jes 5:8-25|Isaiah 5:8-25].
